title: Ike Morgan, Sam Morgan and the banjo player story
summary: Vincent says he played with Ike Morgan's band before Mexico, remembers his brother Sam, and tells a story about a banjo player who was fired.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
